_comment: Register the my-wiki .rag index as an MCP server so any MCP-capable agent can search it.
Copy the 'mcpServers' block into your agent host's own config file — Claude Code, Cursor
and others each read a different location; this file is a source to copy from, not one
The launcher runs the workspace venv, so no interpreter needs to be on PATH.
The 'mcp' extra is already installed in .rag/.venv (mcp 2.0.0).
Tools exposed: rag_search, rag_context, rag_status, rag_sources. All read-only — an agent
can search the index but cannot trigger an index run as a side effect.
